## 25 Things to Do in Cappadocia — The Full List

When people think of Cappadocia, the hot air balloon comes to mind first, but the region is packed with **25+ different activities**. In this guide we review each activity by duration, price and suitability, while also sharing booking links from the Trip and Tick portfolio. On a 3-day Cappadocia holiday you can comfortably enjoy 6-8 different activities.

## 1. Hot Air Balloon Ride (€165-€580)

Cappadocia's signature experience. A 60-90 minute flight at sunrise, gliding over the fairy chimneys, with a champagne landing celebration. Four package options: Standard €165, Comfort €215, Deluxe €295, Romantic Private €580. Open to ages 6 and up; pregnant guests cannot join. Booking: [/balonlar](/balonlar).

## 2. ATV (Quad) Tour (€29-€55)

A guided ATV tour lasting 2-4 hours. Routes through Güllüdere, Red Valley and Love Valley. Single rider €29, two riders €45 on average. The sunset version is the most popular. Details: [/aktiviteler](/aktiviteler).

## 3. Horseback Riding (€35-€75)

The Persian root of the word Cappadocia, "Katpatuka," means "land of beautiful horses." This is the region's traditional activity. 1 hour €35, 2 hours €55, 3-hour sunset trail €75. The romantic trail is a favorite for couples.

## 4. Jeep Safari (4x4) (€45-€85)

An off-road tour lasting 3-8 hours. Hidden valleys, lesser-known fairy chimney clusters, Çat Town and Soğanlı Valley. Half day €45, full day €85. Ideal for families and groups.

## 5. Red Tour — €35

The classic full-day guided tour. Göreme Open Air Museum, Uçhisar Castle, Pasabag (Paşabağı), Devrent Valley, an Avanos ceramic workshop, Üç Güzeller (the Three Beauties) and the Esentepe panorama. 09:30-17:30, Turkish + English guide, lunch included.

## 6. Green Tour — €40

A full-day tour heading south. Ihlara Valley hike (4 km), Selime Monastery (Star Wars filming inspiration), Derinkuyu Underground City (8 levels deep), and the Pigeon Valley panorama. 09:00-17:30. For guests who enjoy walking and stairs.

## 7. Sunset Viewing — Esentepe / Uçhisar / Pasabag (Free)

Cappadocia's golden light is best watched from 3 points: **Esentepe** (a 5-minute walk from Göreme, the best known), **Uçhisar Castle** (60 m elevation, 360° view), and **Pasabag** (Paşabağı, the Three Beauties, with religious significance). Roughly 18:00-20:00 depending on the season.

## 8. Underground City Exploration — Derinkuyu / Kaymaklı / Özkonak (€10-€15 entry)

Underground cities from the 7th-8th century Byzantine era. **Derinkuyu** is 8 levels, 85 meters deep — the deepest. **Kaymaklı** is 4 levels with wider tunnels and less claustrophobia. **Özkonak** is quiet, with few tourists. Each visit takes 45-90 minutes. Closed shoes and a sweater are essential (temperature 12 °C).

## 9. Cave Hotel Stay (€120-€890 / night)

An experience in itself: sleeping inside the tuff rock, showering in a stone bathroom, watching the balloons from a cave terrace. Trip and Tick's cave hotel portfolio has 8 properties, ranging from €120 to €890. Use the concept filter on the [/oteller](/oteller) page.

## 10. Hot Spring Hammam (Kozaklı) (€25-€55)

Thermal springs in the Kozaklı district, 35 minutes from Cappadocia. Source temperatures of 60-75 °C. A resort hammam package (entry + massage) is €55, entry only €25. Said to benefit the skin and joint pain.

## 11. Wine Tour (Avanos / Ürgüp) (€45-€95)

Cappadocia holds a 4,000-year wine tradition. **Turasan**, **Kocabağ** and **Mahzen Şarapçılık** tasting offices. Half day €45, full day €95 with meal. The grape harvest (September-October) is the most beautiful period.

## 12. Photo Tour (With a Professional) (€85-€150)

A 3-5 hour session accompanied by a professional photographer. Sunrise shots with balloon backdrops (Esentepe / Aktepe / Love Valley), then portraits among the fairy chimneys. Delivery of 25-50 edited digital photos. The most popular choice for couples and honeymooners.

## 13. Instagram & Social Media Spots Tour (€55-€85)

Themed, Instagram-friendly spots: the Sultan Cave Suites rooftop terrace (flying carpet), Mithra terrace, the Local Cave Pension lobby, the Argos in Cappadocia courtyard and the El Nazar hidden church. 3-4 hours, with 1 photographer + 1 stylist (outfits provided).

## 14. Troglodyte Villages Walk — Çavuşin / Ortahisar / Mustafapaşa (Free)

"Troglodyte" means a person living in rock-carved homes. In these three villages you can still see rock dwellings in use today. Çavuşin is an abandoned Greek village (pre-1923 population exchange), Ortahisar has a large castle, and Mustafapaşa holds the old Sinasos church. A walk plus coffee break takes half a day.

## 15. Fairy Chimney Observation Points — Pasabag, Devrent, Üç Güzeller (Free)

- **Pasabag (Paşabağı)**: three-headed fairy chimneys, St. Simeon's church
- **Devrent (Imagination Valley)**: animal-shaped rocks — camel, seal, mother and child
- **Üç Güzeller (Three Beauties)**: at the entrance of Ürgüp, mushroom-capped fairy chimneys, the best-known silhouette

Each takes 30-60 minutes to visit. Included in the Red Tour.

## 16. Ihlara Valley Hike (€10 entry)

A 14 km long canyon, 100-150 m deep, in the Aksaray district. The 6-7 km stretch from Selime to Belisırma is walkable (3-4 hours). The canyon holds Byzantine-era church ruins (Sümbüllü, Yılanlı, Ağaçaltı). Restaurants line the riverside at Belisırma.

## 17. Selime Monastery (Free)

An 8th-century monastery at the end of Ihlara Valley. A rock-carved structure that inspired the Tatooine scenes of Star Wars. The stairs are steep, so old shoes are recommended. Included in the Green Tour.

## 18. Göreme Open Air Museum (€20 entry)

UNESCO World Heritage Site. A 10th-century Byzantine monastery complex. 13 churches and chapels — the Dark Church (Karanlık Kilise, extra €5), Yılanlı, Çarıklı, Elmalı and Tokalı are the most important. A 1-hour audio guide is recommended for the 2-3 hour visit.

## 19. Uçhisar Castle (€8 entry)

The highest point in Cappadocia (a 60 m rock). A Byzantine-era defensive structure. From the observation point at the top you get a 360° valley view — Pigeon Valley, Love Valley and Göreme are visible. A 45-60 minute visit. Sunrise and sunset are the golden hours.

## 20. Pasabag (Paşabağı) — Three-Headed Fairy Chimneys (Free)

Cappadocia's most iconic fairy chimney group. Three-capped giant mushroom rocks, 5-6 meters tall. The rock-carved hermit cell of St. Simeon (the Stylite) belongs here. 30-45 minutes.

## 21. Devrent (Imagination) Valley (Free)

"Animal-shaped rocks." You can spot camel, seal, mother and child, snake and dinosaur shapes. The forms look different depending on the season and daylight. A fun game for children in the family.

## 22. Kilim and Carpet Workshop Visit (Free tour, purchase optional)

Traditional carpet workshops between Avanos and Ürgüp. You can watch the silk and wool weaving process live; Hereke, Kayseri and Yahyalı carpets are on display. Free tea service, no pressure to buy. 60-90 minutes.

## 23. Ceramic (Pottery) Workshop — Avanos (Free tour, purchase optional)

Thanks to clay carried by the Kızılırmak (Halys) river, Avanos holds a 4,000-year ceramic tradition. In the pottery workshops you can try shaping clay on the wheel (€10 for designing a mini pot). The Chez Galip workshop (with its hair museum) is the most interesting.

## 24. Anatolian Cuisine — Testi Kebab + Mantı + Boza (€15-€35)

Cappadocia's signature dishes:

- **Testi Kebab**: a meat dish cooked in a clay pot, broken open and served at the table. €25-€35.
- **Mantı**: Kayseri style, with yogurt + sumac. €12-€15.
- **Üzümlü Sucuk**: a regional specialty.
- **Boza** and **Salep**: winter drinks.

Notable restaurants: Topdeck Cave (Göreme), Ziggy Cafe (Ürgüp), Pumpkin (Göreme), Old Greek House (Mustafapaşa).

## 25. Sunrise Yoga and Meditation (€35-€55)

A wellness concept that has grown in recent years. A 60-75 minute yoga + meditation session starting at 05:30 in Love Valley or at Esentepe. Watching the balloons rise into the sky multiplies the meditative experience. Season: April-October.

## Activity Combination Suggestions — 3-Day Plan

**Day 1 (Sunday)**: Balloon ride (morning) → Breakfast at the hotel → Göreme Open Air Museum → Esentepe sunset → Testi Kebab dinner

**Day 2 (Monday)**: Green Tour — Ihlara Valley + Selime + Derinkuyu (full day) → Avanos ceramic workshop → Wine tasting

**Day 3 (Tuesday)**: ATV sunrise tour → Hotel breakfast → Uçhisar Castle → Pasabag → Devrent → Üç Güzeller → Kilim workshop → Cave hotel hammam

## Activity Budget (Per Person)

- Budget 3 days: €280 (balloon + 1 tour + museums + food)
- Mid-range 3 days: €450 (balloon + 2 tours + ATV + restaurants)
- Luxury 3 days: €890 (Deluxe balloon + private jeep + romantic package + photo tour)

## FAQ — Activity Questions

### How many activities can fit in one day in Cappadocia?
With good planning, 3-4 activities are possible: 1) Balloon (morning), 2) Red/Green tour (daytime), 3) Sunset viewing (late afternoon), 4) Restaurant + Turkish night (evening).

### What are the best activities for children?
Devrent Valley (animal-shaped rocks, children love them), Göreme Open Air Museum, making a mini pot at the ceramic workshop, photo shoots at Üç Güzeller. We recommend the underground city for ages 8+.

### Which activities can be done in the rain?
Underground city (Derinkuyu/Kaymaklı), cave restaurants, carpet/ceramic workshops, museums, hammam. Balloons and ATV are usually cancelled in the rain.

### Is there nightlife in Cappadocia?
There are mid-level bars/clubs in central Göreme and Ürgüp. Pasha Lounge, Fat Boys and Red Red Wine House are popular. The wine houses in Ürgüp are lively in the evenings.

### Which activities are suitable for people with disabilities?
Museums (partly), Uçhisar Castle (lowest level), jeep safari (seated), kilim/ceramic workshops are fully accessible. Ask Trip and Tick by email: info@tripandtick.com.

### How many days should the whole Cappadocia trip take?
A minimum of 2 nights / 3 days (balloon + 1 tour + museum). Ideally 3 nights / 4 days (all major activities). For 5+ days you can add Ihlara, hot springs, a photo tour and valley hikes.

### Which activity is most often skipped?
The Çavuşin troglodyte village and Mustafapaşa (Sinasos) — far from the tourist crowds, authentic. Trip and Tick's photo tour routes include these spots.

### Can a wine tasting and balloon ride be done on the same day?
Yes. The balloon is at 05:30-08:30 in the morning, wine tasting at 14:00-17:00 in the afternoon. A busy day but a compatible combination.

### Which activity is most romantic for honeymoon couples?
The combination of the Romantic Private Balloon (€580, a basket for just 2 people) + Cave Hotel + Professional Photo Tour. Trip and Tick's honeymoon package starts at €580 on the [/paketler](/paketler) page; it includes 2 nights at a cave hotel + balloon + photos + romantic dinner.

### Can activities be booked online?
Yes, all activities are booked online at Trip and Tick on the [/aktiviteler](/aktiviteler) page. Visa/Mastercard/Amex/UnionPay accepted, 3D Secure active, with EUR/TRY/USD options. The PDF voucher is sent to your email instantly. Loyalty points (every €1 = 1 point) are earned on all bookings.

### In which languages are activities conducted?
Turkish and English are standard. German, French, Spanish, Chinese and Arabic guides can be arranged with advance booking. Trip and Tick's 9-language website provides built-in support (TR/EN/DE/FR/ES/NL/ZH/HI/UR-RTL). Our WhatsApp support line is open for messaging 24/7.
